mods.name: Luminance
mods.notes: Library mod; tested package metadata version 1.0.3, loader 2026.7.3.0. A recorded compatibility patch replaces obsolete unnamed SetFactory usage required by current tML 1.4.4.9 ModCompile.

mods.name: Fargowiltas
mods.notes: Pinned to the upstream commit whose build.txt reports version 3.3.6.7.

mods.name: StructureHelper
mods.notes: Bundled as lib/StructureHelper.dll inside the tested Fargo's Souls package; source tag 3.1.1 matches build.txt. Recorded patches replace AssGen 3.0.0's Windows-path-only source generation with the equivalent asset wrapper for Linux container builds.

mods.name: FargowiltasSouls
mods.notes: Primary tested content mod. Known Switch performance: in-world median about 55 fps on hardware (v16, run 42).

mods.name: RecipeBrowser
mods.license: Not declared (source-available; author states it is not open source)
mods.notes: Hooks On_Recipe.FindRecipes and On_Player.AdjTiles, lowered offline. The Armor Sets tab computes every head/body/legs combination synchronously on first open; with Fargo's content expect a long pause. Opens only by hotkey (default ], unassigned until set in Settings > Controls). Its search boxes cannot receive text on this build.

mods.name: BossChecklist
mods.notes: Hooks On_Player.ApplyMusicBox and On_Main.UpdateTime_StartDay/StartNight (ref bool), lowered offline. Fargo's Souls registers its bosses through Boss Checklist's Mod.Call API. The checklist opens only by hotkey (default P); the Boss Log by hotkey (default L) or the book button in the inventory. Both hotkeys stay unassigned until set in Settings > Controls.

mods.name: WheresMyItems
mods.notes: Pinned to the net8 project fix of the 0.8 release. No hooks. Opens only by hotkey (default Delete, unassigned until set in Settings > Controls). Its search, which also covers Magic Storage hearts when Magic Storage is loaded, is a text box that cannot receive text on this build, so it cannot search.

mods.name: CheatSheet
mods.notes: No hooks. Steam-only online schematics are disabled upstream. Its exception reporter uploads errors over HTTP. Some panels read the raw mouse, so use touch; searches cannot receive text on this build. The hotbar opens from its tab at the bottom of the screen or by hotkey (default K, unassigned until set in Settings > Controls) and hides HERO's Mod's toolbar while shown.

mods.name: HEROsMod
mods.notes: Hooks On_Player.ChatColor and On_NPC.SpawnOnPlayer, lowered offline. Its UI reads the raw mouse, so use touch; text fields cannot receive text on this build. At 1280x720 its toolbar covers the inventory's Settings button and Boss Checklist's Boss Log button; collapse it with the tab above it. In multiplayer the first registered account becomes admin.

mods.name: SerousCommonLib
mods.notes: Library mod required by Magic Storage; LICENSE.txt is the MIT text with unfilled [year] [fullname] placeholders. Recorded patches replace its Reflection.Emit field accessors and deep cloner with reflection-based equivalents (same public API, slower), replace UnsafeAccessor Guid field reads with Guid.TryWriteBytes, and let its IL edit wrapper run when edits are applied offline at build time.

mods.name: MagicStorage
mods.notes: Recorded patches reference SerousCommonLib.dll from the checkout root and drop a C# 13-only ref struct interface so the .NET 8 SDK builds it; express its IL edits as static manipulators and static injected calls so all 25 apply offline; and let the craft and amount buttons accept the game's click (gamepad A, touch) as well as the mouse. Its search box cannot receive text on this build. Upstream issue #295 reported storage problems in some Fargo's Souls runs (unconfirmed): check deposit, withdraw and save/reload.

mods.name: AlchemistNPCLite
mods.notes: Upstream has no project file; a recorded patch adds one built against Fargo's Souls for the Operator's Fargo shops. Redemption and Shards of Atheria are not in this catalog, so a recorded patch removes only their compile-time downed-flag code and the shop entries using it. The full AlchemistNPC has no source for the current loader.
